blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

faq.a: Cameron Elementary and Lyndhurst Elementary are the closest elementary schools named here. The Province lists Cameron Elementary (K–7) at 9540 Erickson Dr and Lyndhurst Elementary (K–7) at 9847 Lyndhurst St. Catchments are address-based, so run the exact address through the locator.

This Oakdale is in Burnaby for schools. Its houses fall under School District 41, with elementary schools (K–7) and secondary schools (8–12) and no middle-school tier. That differs from Coquitlam across North Road, so do not apply its school list here.
faq.q: Is Oakdale in Burnaby or Coquitlam for schools?

faq.a: Burnaby Mountain Secondary is the secondary school named for this area. The Province lists it at 8800 Eastlake Dr (8–12), on the same corridor as the area's elementary schools. Catchment is address-based, so confirm the specific street in the locator.
